import pandas as pd, numpy as np, cv2
from shapely.geometry import Polygon
a=pd.read_csv('demo_metadata.csv'); b=pd.read_csv('out/demo_metadata.csv')
print(a.shape,b.shape, (a.drop(columns=['xmin','xmax','ymin','ymax','coords_x','coords_y'])==b.drop(columns=['xmin','xmax','ymin','ymax','coords_x','coords_y'])).all().all())
P=[]
for _,r in b.iterrows():
    xs=list(map(int,r.coords_x.split(','))); ys=list(map(int,r.coords_y.split(',')))
    p=Polygon(zip(xs,ys)); P.append(p)
    assert p.is_valid, r.name
    assert len(set(xs))>2 or len(set(ys))>2
    assert (min(xs),max(xs),min(ys),max(ys))==(r.xmin,r.xmax,r.ymin,r.ymax)
ov=[(i,j) for i in range(len(P)) for j in range(i+1,len(P)) if P[i].intersects(P[j])]
print('overlaps',ov)
rect=[i for i,p in enumerate(P) if abs(p.area-p.envelope.area)<1e-6]; print('rects',rect)
ious=[]
for (_,r),p in zip(a.iterrows(),P):
    xs=list(map(int,r.coords_x.split(','))); ys=list(map(int,r.coords_y.split(',')))
    q=Polygon(zip(xs,ys)).buffer(0); ious.append(p.intersection(q).area/p.union(q).area)
a['iou']=ious; print(a.groupby('type').iou.describe())
im=cv2.imread('demo_rgb.png'); big=cv2.resize(im,None,fx=3,fy=3,interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST)
for (_,r),p in zip(a.iterrows(),P):
    xs=np.array(list(map(int,r.coords_x.split(','))));ys=np.array(list(map(int,r.coords_y.split(','))))
    cv2.polylines(big,[np.stack([xs,ys],1)*3],True,(255,0,0),1)
    cv2.polylines(big,[np.array(p.exterior.coords,np.int32)*3],True,(0,255,0),2)
cv2.imwrite('/tmp/obench-cell-nictcfdj/bench_opencode_sam-cell-seg_oxxu9nkf/viz.png',big)
EOF
